Drug & Alcohol Policy We are regulated by the United States Coast Guard, all federal, state and local laws apply to our yacht and we must abide by them to stay in business.
California Alcohol & Beverage Control regulations are in place for all guests.
Guests must be 21+ to consume alcohol.

We regulate the amount of guests' alcohol consumption to prevent over serving per ABC regulations, any overuse of alcohol that presents a threat to the safety of the charter will result in the immediate termination of the charter.

services.name: Santa Barbara Harbor and Waterfront Tour
services.desc: Join us on the water for a relaxing cruise! About On our cruise you will explore the Santa Barbara Harbor, Waterfront, and Stearns Wharf with a narrated tour and magnificent views of the American Riviera coastline with occasional views of wildlife like sea lions, dolphins, and more. More Info We ask that you kindly remove your shoes before boarding. Catering options are available during checkout. A ships bar is aboard with local offerings of beer, wine, water, soft drinks and light snacks. Bring your own food for $75. We do not allow swimming from the yacht. Capacity Please note, while this 60-90 Minutes • All Ages • Up to 6 Passengers

services.name: Memorial At Sea
services.desc: The Santa Barbara Harbor and surrounding Channel Islands are often locations with special meaning. About SunSwept Sailing offers a dignified ash scattering service and memorial at sea aboard the classic sailing yacht, Kelpie, with tranquil vistas of the Pacific Ocean. Let us take care of all the details so you’re free to spend cherished time with family and friends in remembrance of your loved one. Pricing includes permit filing, flowers for scattering, and a framed Memorial Certificate printed with your loved one(s) / pet(s) name(s) and the GPS coordinates of their final resting place. More 1-3 Hours • All Ages • Up to 6 Passengers

services.name: Sound Bath Sail
services.desc: Wellness on the Water 75 minutes (60 minute Sound Bath) Our wellness cruises have been thoughtfully designed to accommodate couples, families, or small groups, giving a unique experience that blends sound, serenity, and a profound connection with self and the sea. Booking required 7 days in advance. Last minute bookings may be available by special request. Sound Bath Sail Step aboard for a unique sound bath sail amidst the the soothing lull of the sea and the resonant harmonies of hand bells, chimes, and therapeutic singing bowls from Nepal. services.name: 4th of July Sunset Sail & Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Watch the 4th of July Fireworks from aboard your own private sailing yacht! We depart just after sunset and head out of the harbor to float adjacent to Sterns Wharf to watch the show. The cruise is roughly an hour, timing depends on how long the harbor entrance is closed by the U.S. Coast Guard. Champagne and a cheese/charcuterie board are provided. 21+ Your private group of up to 6 guests will enjoy a sunset sail and stay out for the fireworks show!
